reviews.text: I first consulted Marie Andrée when we decided to adopt a Siberian cat. My husband had never had a cat before and was apprehensive. She was a great help, and her advice was spot on. Since then, I've called her back for various minor issues. She's a great listener and knows how to guide us. I highly recommend her services.

I'm lucky enough to have welcomed a Somarie kitten. Marie-Andree gave me excellent advice on welcoming Bella, and her adjustment to the house went wonderfully well. I 100% recommend this breeder because you can truly feel their love for cats, their passion, and their knowledge of this feline. Bella is an adorable and very well-balanced kitten; it shows! 😍
Great, I highly recommend Marie Andrée! Since her visit, I've seen a real change in my cat's behavior! Thank you for the follow-up :)

I welcomed a little kitten into my home to join my two adopted cats. She was exhibiting behavioral problems, including urinating outside the litter box. Marie-Andrée was an invaluable help; she analyzed everything that wasn't working in our home to address Missy's problem and ensure the harmony of all three cats. She gave me sound advice, suggested modifications, replacements, and additions to things like litter boxes, litter, food bowls, and toys, and also advised me on how to interact with the cats during play and training. Once all of this was implemented, my little kitten is doing much better. She's happy at home, she no longer urinates outside the litter box, and her stress is decreasing. The whole family gets along well! For anyone who has cats with behavioral issues or other problems, don't hesitate to contact Marie-Andrée; her expertise and professionalism are invaluable. I recommend her! Thank you for your help, Marie-Andrée.

Marie-Andrée assisted our family as a behaviorist during our adoption of an adorable Siberian kitten.

She provided invaluable advice and helped us give our cat the warmest welcome, while also trying to understand how to best "live together" with them, which isn't as intuitive as it seems. :) We highly recommend Marie-Andrée!

We benefited from Marie-Andrée's excellent advice when welcoming our Siberian kitten at almost 13 weeks old. Her extensive expertise and availability allowed us to avoid many mistakes and set up a safe space, a suitable litter box, and a balanced diet for our little Alaska, who was able to adapt smoothly and without stress to his new environment. The first week went perfectly :) We wouldn't hesitate to contact her again if needed in the future.
A huge thank you!

Marie-Andrée was the breeder of the kitten I've had for the past three months. She arrived in perfect health, incredibly sociable, clean, and calm. In short, she received all the attention she needed for her development and a solid foundation to thrive throughout her life!

We are absolutely delighted with our experience with Somarie! We were supported, prepared, and advised with great professionalism and kindness. We were able to communicate regularly before the cat's arrival (photos, videos, advice on preparing for his arrival, food, toys, litter box, outdoor space, cat routines...), everything was detailed and accompanied by examples. Thanks to her guidance, the arrival of our little kitten went perfectly. We couldn't have dreamed of anything better. As for the kitten, he is so cuddly, calm, well-balanced, clean from the start, and absolutely beautiful!!! Thank you, Somarie!

Here is my beautiful Aïka de Somarie, adopted at the beginning of January. My meeting with Marie Andrée was a turning point, and I can't thank her enough for entrusting Aïka to me; I truly fell in love with her instantly. I highly recommend this Siberian breeder, a kind and passionate person, calm and loving, who passes on her love of her cats so much that she shares her best with you! As a behaviorist, she doesn't hesitate to help you with the arrival of your kitten, offering excellent and wise advice, both for you and for the cat's well-being. Her animals are magnificent, incredibly sociable, and Ms. Gagnon is undoubtedly the best breeder I have ever met. If I have any further questions, I contact her, and she answers them with her professionalism.

Fantastic experience!

She was a top-notch person: very responsive, professional, and a great listener. She gave us excellent advice and found effective solutions for the minor issues we were having with our cat.

In addition to being highly competent, she's also very friendly, which immediately puts you at ease. You can tell she knows her job inside and out and is truly dedicated to finding the best solutions for every situation.

I highly recommend her without hesitation!

Thank you so much for your help in remotely resolving the difficulties I'm having with my cat. I appreciate the clarity of your communications, your availability, your undeniable (and excellent) skills, and your kindness. See you soon, sincerely.
Available and attentive, thank you for your wise advice.

By necessity, I live with a Siberian cat in a 33m² apartment. He's young and super active—just like me 😅. Marie-Andrée has transformed our daily life. Before she came, Taïga was always dissatisfied, looking for the next mischief to get into, and most importantly, he woke me up every morning... around 5:30 or 6:00. The situation had become a bit desperate. Since Marie-Andrée's visit—which lasted several hours—life has become much easier! No more meowing, no more mischief, Taïga is calm, and we've rediscovered a happy daily life together—and I've finally gotten my sleep back. A huge thank you for your help and for being so available until all the bad habits were completely broken 🙏

Marie is always available and generous with her advice, both before and after adoption. Her support is reassuring, caring, and always delivered with passion.

Marie has a profound approach to behavioral therapy, allowing kittens to grow up in a calm and stimulating environment.
Our little Siberian kitten is a treasure, sweet and well-balanced, and arrived in the best possible conditions. I recommend her without hesitation! 🐱🩵

We were so lucky to adopt our little Athena from this exceptional breeder, and we couldn't have dreamed of anything better. From the very beginning, she proved to be professional, passionate, and deeply caring.

The fact that she is not only a breeder but also a behaviorist was a real advantage. Thanks to her invaluable advice and her great availability, we were able to welcome Athena in the best possible conditions. She guided us every step of the way, always with kindness, and answered all our questions with patience and expertise.

Thanks to her, Athena's arrival went very smoothly. Her adaptation was quick and natural, and today she is thriving: playful, affectionate, curious, and confident—a true joy every day. This reflects all the love, dedication, and care she puts into her breeding program.

We wholeheartedly recommend this breeder to anyone looking to adopt a kitten with complete confidence or who is experiencing behavioral issues with their cat. A huge thank you again for everything you've done for us and for Athena 💕.

I would like to highlight Marie-Andrée's qualities not only as a breeder but also as a cat behaviorist. When I adopted my kitten, she gave me a lot of advice, demonstrating her passion and excellent knowledge of these furry friends.

I contacted Marie-Andrée in desperation: my cat, whom I had just adopted and already loved with all my heart, wouldn't stop meowing—from 5 a.m. until night. I was worried about him and wondered if he was really suited to apartment living. Marie-Andrée reassured me from the very first call. We quickly made an appointment. She is a very thorough, attentive, and empathetic specialist. We spent almost three hours together; she studied the cat's behavior and his environment, asked many very specific questions, and, most importantly, explained the reasons for this behavior very clearly. The next day, I received a report of our appointment with a list of recommendations, tips, and games. Marie-Andrée remains available until the problem is resolved.
It's been a little over two weeks, and I'm already seeing results: I'm following the advice, and the cat seems much calmer and happier! Thank you!

To date, I've consulted several behaviorists for my cat's anxiety, aggression, and stress issues, and today I found the best one!

And that's Marie-Andrée! She completely resolved the problems at home by providing the right solutions and the best advice. I'm so glad I contacted her because we've finally regained the peace and quiet we'd lost for so long. I can't thank her enough; it has truly changed our lives. Thank you! 🐈
A fantastic experience, Marie Andree is very attentive and a wealth of knowledge and wise advice.

It was our first time consulting a feline behaviorist, and it was a very good decision! There are many misconceptions about how to care for a cat, and Marie-Andrée perfectly guided us through settling in with our new Bengal companion. Even after the appointment, Marie-Andrée was very available by phone to help us with some issues related to meowing. I highly recommend her; she's fantastic!
Marie gave us excellent advice for the arrival of our kitten, who quickly settled in! We understand his little mischief better now, and we've adopted new habits that improve how we live together!

An exceptional experience! We adopted a Siberian kitten who is truly exceptional: very beautiful, lively, intelligent, and incredibly affectionate. We received invaluable support from our first contact with the cat until his arrival home, with helpful advice, and everything is going exactly as Marie-Andrée promised. We are absolutely delighted!

First of all, a huge thank you! 🙏🏼 My cat had been urinating inappropriately since he was a kitten (3 months old). It wasn't territorial marking. I consulted two veterinarians, and even they couldn't explain this behavioral problem after ruling out a urinary tract infection. I tried both types of litter, repellents, and Fediway devices, all to no avail. I was getting really depressed—doing laundry every day, replacing two sofas, it was a nightmare. Marie André came to my home, took the time to analyze my cat's environment, gave us advice, provided follow-up, and today, thank you!! My mental health and my wallet thank you. Cookie now urinates in his litter box, and my nights are no longer interrupted. I recommend her 100%. My only regret is not having contacted you sooner.

Marie Andrée gave us invaluable advice on how to best prepare for the arrival of our feline friend, carefully explaining how to welcome him and adapt our lives to him. She shared her expertise clearly and thoughtfully, guiding us through the important steps to ensure a smooth transition. Her practical advice and caring approach were essential in understanding a cat's needs and creating a welcoming and peaceful environment for our feline companion. We highly recommend her services, both for her competence and her warm and professional approach.

A huge thank you to Marie, who gave us the best advice for welcoming our kitten home in October. Thanks to her, we have a wonderfully healthy, happy, and cuddly kitten. Marie is always available and does so with such kindness. We wholeheartedly recommend her services to help you welcome your pet into your home and connect with them, building a beautiful relationship. We are so happy! Thank you again from the bottom of our hearts.

Marie-Andrée was a great help with our cat who was meowing at night and hasn't done it since she came. She's as friendly as she is competent and really takes the time to get to know the cat and the family. She sends a very thorough report, gives lots of personalized advice, and follows up two weeks after her visit. I highly recommend her!

We contacted Marie-Andrée about our dog's accidents outside the litter box. She gave us excellent advice and took the time to explain everything about this little problem, and she also answered other questions we had. Plus, she's really lovely! Since then, everything has been sorted out. A big thank you!

For several months, we had a problem with our cat urinating outside the litter box, which seemed unsolvable. I knew Marie through the Somarie Siberian cat breeder, and from our first meeting, I knew I was dealing with a highly professional individual. When it came to resolving this urinary issue, it didn't even occur to me to contact anyone else.
Marie listened attentively, asked perfectly relevant questions, and gave us advice that allowed us to resolve the problem in just one month. She also helped us improve our relationship with our cat by giving us a better understanding of his communication methods. We are incredibly grateful to her.

We are extremely happy and satisfied with the work done by Marie André. Thanks to her invaluable advice, our cat has stopped urinating outside his litter box and seems much more relaxed.

She took the time to understand the situation and provided us with solutions.
Excellent listening skills, availability, professionalism, and kindness. I felt confident and well-advised. Thank you again for your guidance and support. I will recommend you without hesitation.

We adopted our Siberian cat from Marie-Andrée in October 2024. Passionate and attentive, she was there to advise us at every stage of preparing for the arrival of our little Walter. Thanks to her guidance, Walter is a well-adjusted and happy kitten.

I should add that, being allergic to cats, I was afraid of having a reaction. But nothing at all! I'm so glad I took the plunge.

Very satisfied with the advice and the time taken to clearly explain things and how to handle my 2-year-old Siberian cat.

We had already discussed her diet.

Don't hesitate to contact Somarie - cat behaviorist 🐱, I highly recommend her.
Have a lovely day!

Marie-Andrée came to my house because of a problem with my cat urinating on my bed. The situation was very critical; I was sometimes having three accidents a day. With excellent listening skills and insightful questions, Marie-Andrée immediately implemented changes. Thanks to her attentiveness and excellent communication, Marie-Andrée managed to resolve the problem! She was also attentive to my two other cats, ensuring they lived together harmoniously and in a comfortable environment. I am delighted with her visit, and so are my cats.

We highly recommend this Siberian cat breeder; it's a small, family-run business. Marie-Andrée is a passionate breeder who gave us invaluable advice on welcoming our adorable kitten this summer. As a feline behaviorist, she was also always very available to answer any questions we had about cats in general.

Marie was a tremendous help in preparing for the arrival of my kitten, Yoshi. As a feline behaviorist, she gave me invaluable advice to ensure Yoshi's smooth transition to his new environment. Her expertise and passion for cats shine through in every interaction. I highly recommend her to anyone seeking guidance on welcoming and understanding their feline companion.
Thank you so much :)

I want to thank Marie for her high standards, dedication, and passion for the feline world.

Her experience as a breeder and her numerous professional qualifications are invaluable.

I am a breeder and regularly consult her for her feline behaviorist expertise.
She guides me with kindness, her advice is always relevant, and she brings well-being and balance to my group of Siberians at all stages of life.

I recommend her services to all breeders (and individuals) who are committed to understanding their feline(s).

Madame Plume Cattery 🌸

Excellent work and, above all, a very good analysis of my cat's behavior.

I highly recommend Marie and thank her again for her invaluable help.

I adopted a kitten from the Somarie cattery three months ago.
Thanks to the advice Marie-Andrée Gagnon gave me, his arrival home went very smoothly. He felt right at home within minutes. He's a very sociable and affectionate kitten.
Whenever I have a question about his behavior, I ask her, and thanks to her, everything is resolved quickly.
I highly recommend Ms. Gagnon.

After buying one of her kittens, both the kitten and we ourselves had a few hiccups settling in perfectly at the farm. Thanks to Marie Andrée's excellent advice, our little Parisian was able to take advantage of the positive changes, and we saw a very quick improvement.

Thank you again.
